name: oorexx_socket_provider

bindings.XTP: bundled XtpSocketProvider.cls adapter for external libxtp/oorexx_xtp_native dev17
bindings.NORM: external oorexx_norm provider; libnorm mechanics isolated below SocketProvider
bindings.UDP: bundled ordinary IPv4 RxSock datagram binding plus injected RFC 3678 multicast backend

familyExample: TLS over INET with security-profile-only address and injected material authority

intentions.authority: Intention supplies semantic requirements; SocketNegotiator selects current qualified offer; SocketProvider alone acquires native handle

negotiation.xtp_dev9_rexx: sender available; listener fail-closed; multicast not implemented by current executable profile
negotiation.multicast: requires multicast-capable current implementation and explicitly multicast endpoint address
negotiation.norm_dev1: superseded by oorexx_norm 0.1-dev2; NORM remains non-stream reliable multicast
negotiation.xtp_dev10_rexx: sender and listener available; multicast not implemented by current executable profile
negotiation.xtp_dev12_rexx: sender/listener plus XTP-owned multipath/path-health; multicast not implemented by current executable profile
negotiation.xtp_dev14_rexx: sender and listener available; multicast explicitly false in current executable profile
negotiation.xtp_dev17_rexx: sender/listener/stream/multicast available; multicast streaming is stream=true + multicast=true

compatibility.oorexx_xtp: 0.1-dev17 current line: sender/listener/stream/multicast yes; ALLOC pacing and reject suppression remain XTP-owned
compatibility.xtp: dev9/dev10/dev12/dev14 retained as historical profiles; dev17 is current stream+multicast profile
compatibility.oorexx_norm: 0.1-dev3 explicit membership plus descriptor/readiness; live IPv4/IPv6 libnorm qualification owned by NORM package
compatibility.rxsock6: oorexx_socket_provider_rxsock6_v0.1-dev1 + rxsock6 0.1.1; sibling TCP6/INET6 binding preserves native Inet6Address objects
compatibility.quic: oorexx_quic_socket_provider_v0.1-dev1; sibling OpenSSL QUIC binding behind SocketProvider

udp_ip_multicast.address_factory: SocketAddresses~ipMulticast supports legacy logical-name form and interface/source-aware form
udp_ip_multicast.native_provider: external; common provider does not issue RFC 3678 operations

descriptor_readiness.authority: delegation only; transport/provider owns readiness mechanics

udp_datagram.multicast_backend: RexxUdpSocketBinding remains separate injected provider seam

xtp_provider_merge.authority: libxtp owns routes, carriers, replay, wire filters, path health, multipath and XTP multicast mechanics
